title: AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian: a self-organizing Markdown knowledge base
friendlyTitle: Build an AI-organized second brain in Obsidian
summary: Claude Obsidian combines Obsidian and Claude Code to read incoming sources, create links, and organize them into a user-owned knowledge graph of plain Markdown. The project had about 11,700 stars when checked, making it one of the most popular AI-focused repositories in the day’s candidate set.
friendlySummary: This project uses Claude Code to sort sources and connect notes inside an Obsidian vault made of normal Markdown files.
whyItMatters: It offers a starting point for a local, portable research or personal-knowledge workflow in which notes remain ordinary files rather than being locked inside a hosted AI notebook service.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can help organize research while keeping your notes in files you own and can move elsewhere.
